topics.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO after 33 years; Colette Kress named interim CEO
topics.summary: Nvidia announced on November 12, 2026, that co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO, and board member effective immediately following personal conduct disclosures. Longtime CFO Colette Kress was appointed Interim CEO while the board conducts a successor search. Harvey C. Jones was named the first independent Board Chair.

topics.title: Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2 to model genetic variant effects on single cells
topics.summary: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2 on November 11, 2026, a conditional DNA sequence model trained on over 100 million single-cell profiles across 68 tissues. The model predicts cell-type-specific effects of non-coding genetic variants, doubling the identification of causal expression quantitative trait loci over its predecessor.

topics.title: Norwest closes record $4 billion Norwest 18 fund targeting artificial intelligence
topics.summary: Global multi-stage investment firm Norwest announced the close of Norwest 18 on November 12, 2026, a $4 billion fund bringing total capital under management to $18 billion. The firm plans to invest across technology, healthcare, and consumer sectors, with a targeted emphasis on physical AI, voice agents, and agentic cybersecurity.
